About This Chatbot

This AI chatbot provides information about human trafficking, including definitions, statistics, warning signs, and resources for help.

The information is sourced from authoritative organizations such as:

  • United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC)
  • International Labour Organization (ILO)
  • Polaris Project
  • Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Blue Campaign

This chatbot is designed to provide educational information only and is not a substitute for professional advice or emergency services.

Privacy Notice

This chatbot does not store personal information. Conversations are not retained after the session ends.
